text:
Max Crozier is a 26-year-old fourth-round pick who has turned into a useful depth defenseman for the Lightning, and he hasn't played since Nov 14. Tampa has won both games it has finished since.

When he has played, he's been solid enough: 17 minutes a night, three assists in 12 games, and Tampa takes about 55% of the expected goals with him on at five on five, though slightly better without him. No goals on 1.1 expected.

Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking, from a small sample last season, had one clear weakness: only 18% of his exits kept possession, so watch for clears off the glass under pressure. Evolving-Hockey had most of his modest value coming on the penalty kill.

He came up through the USHL and Providence College. What to watch: whether he gets back into the lineup as Tampa's injuries clear, or stays out while the current group keeps winning.
